## Installing

1. Download `prospero-win-<version>.zip` below and unzip it. You get a folder
   called `PPSA99995`.
2. Upload that folder to `/data/homebrew/` on your PS5 and let your loader
   register it.
3. Follow [Getting started](https://github.com/mpereiraesaa/prospero-win/blob/main/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md)
   to add your first game.

`SHA256SUMS` lets you check the download: `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`.

Updating from an earlier version: replace the whole `PPSA99995` folder. Your
games, profiles and prefixes live in `/data/prospero-win` and are kept.
